title: Integrate resident SCALE2 into the complete scalar policy (no κ)
body:
This integrates [Nick Petalas6608's resident SCALE2 edge](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6608) into [Ali Romman6530's complete exclusive-field policy](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6530). At W64, the attained optimum in the declared enlarged policy class is **800,328,108D - 5,109,750**, saving **519,652D - 8,448** against the credited baseline for every integerD>=1. The retained path uses31 resident SCALE edges. No κ or frontier change.

Only an already-resident literal SCALE2 target gains an edge: its physical bank and owner-head location stay fixed, at the credited cost3284D-2. All old eviction/acquisition interleavings, SCALE flush alternatives and native/reset/final boundaries remain. Workspace is unchanged:102272D owner bits,256D staging bits, one carry and two finite-control bits on four tapes. No prefetch, physical bank swap, unpriced head move or read from an evacuated owner.

The actual selected word gives22,805 layers. The independently reconstructed baseline has59,170 states/314,133 edges/max4; the candidate59,276/314,589/max5. Written graph/composition proof plus complete affine potentials check every edge over the whole D>=1 ray, and full attaining actions check ownership and boundary restoration. D1/D2 minima only propose the potentials; they do not establish the universal inequalities.

Both blind-first engines agree. Normal/optimized independent checks consume every actual submitted layer, potential, action, edge and literal route as data, including all-D residuals and complete attaining ownership paths. The retained canonical policy is6,395,795B, SHA2563d76f16b60f912d855e66dd36904e80ea341898dd25f56fa10fb20e6d6e4b56f. Local resident-route evidence covers386 basis columns,43 signed fixtures, both physical bank bindings and literal inverse; source129-column comparison is a credited dependency check. Fixed spectator fixtures and the syntactic no-spectator-access argument are distinguished. No full native/reset payload or full-owner-state enumeration is claimed.

All scientific code,15 source objects, cases/schema, first receipts and policy container remain unchanged. Oracle9 typed and9 semantic controls pass; primary has no separate internal negative group. All26 external intended rejections, four registered commands, committed byte/declared-source-history/mode checks, final official export/declared-POLICY input check and four read-only Git-free empty-PATH cold commands pass. Root diagnostic-label expectation corrections are preserved with all partial runs and mutants; scientific engines/inputs never changed. Final tested tree2db13e8f8d730fd4092264706835415ade019dbb. Hosted CI succeeded on original run `41747482729`: 711 helper tests (24 skipped), all four registered package commands including both independent checks of the actual complete policy/ownership/route data, and both staged/unstaged drift checks passed. Synthetic test commit `a6284481d3a80a449e5f14196162cb73daf7846a` has the exact verified tree and expected main/PR parents; no actual merge occurred. Mode, source-history and export checks above were local.

Source heads:6608 `2ca05908bf16e353b3fd14e4db7407aa47f661e8`,6530 `fadaba3bb16a6965fa5e9c2c7af3a9df6ddf01bf`. Main7c49fe32, eight guidance bindings, selected6030, exact source feedback, latest open page and liveHub refreshed unchanged before publication. The independent-moment card is explicitly changed to the complete physical scalar invoice; full paid/target supplier admission remains separate.

The43 local template prices/correctness and original arithmetic headroom remain inherited premises. Native grids,7936D reset requests, initial layout, uniform encoded-D control, precision/stock, complete supplier and outer bills remain obligations, never zero. Credit Nick Petalas6608/scalar circuits; Ali Romman6530/6527/6513/6511; Sagar Thakrar3241; DreamingOfClouds6030; ywz65/2545 residency/restricted-DP context and retained native/compiler/precision lineage. Source notices retained. ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex and separate AI primary/oracle/static review, Apache-2.0; no human/kernel acceptance claimed.
